title: My Favorite Scene
brief: Hoo! We finished The Whipping Boy! Pick your favorite scene from the whole book. Build it with four models, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is your choice. Pick a scene from the castle, the forest or the fair, then pick the four models that fit it best.

models.name: Brass Ink Well
models.why: Jemmy learns to read and write

steps.title: Pick your models
steps.text: Pick a scene from the book. Then pick **four** of these six models that fit it. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.note: 🗺️ Type **Medieval** and pick the map that fits your scene: forest, town or castle.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Add your **four** models. Set them up the way they look in your scene.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “My favorite scene is when ___. I picked it because ___.”
steps.text: Point to your scene and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to your scene and say this out loud. My favorite scene is when… I picked it because…

extra.text: Build a **second** scene with the other two models. Say which part of the book it shows.

points: Your photo shows four models that fit one scene from the book.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what happened in the book and tap who did it. Then finish two sentences about the whole story.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think back through the whole book.
mapday.done: ✓ You know who did it all. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: The castle, with a spot for each character

clues.q: Dumped bullfrogs in the moat so no one could sleep.
Ate garlic to “fend off the plague.”
Chased Jemmy through the forest, “breathing like a bellows.”
Hid from Cutwater inside a hollow tree.
Snapped the whip across the prince’s back.
Asked the king to make Petunia the Official Dancing Bear.
